promotion.promotion_gate: At least one real pull request must show capital-ai-ci PASS before this expected policy is promoted to a live GitHub ruleset.
promotion.rollback: Do not enable the new ruleset if capital-ai-ci is missing, ambiguous, skipped unexpectedly, or failing. Preserve normal PR workflow and repair on a fresh branch.

single_owner_topology.rationale: A mandatory independent GitHub approval would deadlock the current single-owner repository. HIGH/CRITICAL agent actions remain subject to CAPITAL-AI capability, approval and step-up controls until an independent reviewer exists.
single_owner_topology.promotion_condition: Enable at least one independent approving review and code-owner enforcement when a distinct trusted reviewer identity is available.
